stories.title: Volley. Sorpresa e delusione: l'Italia è fuori, eliminata dalla Finlandia

en.title: Volleyball. Surprise and disappointment: Italy is out, eliminated by Finland
en.summary: Italy, the reigning world champions, was eliminated by Finland in the quarterfinals despite finishing first in their group and defeating Denmark 3-0 in the previous round.

stories.title: Europei volley, incredibile Italia, in vantaggio al tie-break va fuori con la Finlandia

en.title: European volleyball, incredible Italy, ahead at tie-break goes out to Finland
en.summary: Italy lost 3-2 to Finland in the quarterfinals in Turin, with Finland advancing to the semifinals in Milan to face France.

stories.title: Il ricordo di Andrea Moretti, il giovane operaio morto mentre lavorava al Colosseo

en.title: Remembrance of Andrea Moretti, the young worker who died while working at the Colosseum
en.summary: A young construction worker died while working at the Colosseum in Rome, affecting a family that had previously experienced a serious workplace accident involving the victim's father.

stories.title: Larissa Brito, uccisa e fatta a pezzi dall'ex compagno a Nizza. L'ultimo messaggio: "Lui è qui"

en.title: Larissa Brito, killed and dismembered by her ex-partner in Nice. The last message: "He is here"
en.summary: A 25-year-old model was killed in southern France, with her ex-partner arrested on suspicion of the crime. She had been attempting to distance herself from him before her death.

stories.title: Nizza, modella di 25 anni uccisa dall’ex compagno: il corpo sfregiato trovato nel bagagliaio dell’auto

en.title: Nice, 25-year-old model killed by ex-partner: disfigured body found in car trunk
en.summary: A 25-year-old Brazilian model named Larissa Brito from São Paulo was found dead in a car trunk in Nice with signs of violence. Her ex-partner has been arrested in connection with the case.

stories.title: Ramoscelli d’ulivo e kefiah, i “preti contro il genocidio” in corteo intorno al Vaticano

en.title: Olive branches and keffiyeh, the "priests against genocide" in procession around the Vatican
en.summary: A network of over 2,000 priests across various countries formed last year in response to events in Gaza has organized a procession near the Vatican, calling for an end to war narratives and promotion of nonviolence and diplomatic solutions.

stories.title: Andrea Moretti, chi era l’operaio morto al Colosseo: la passione per i cavalli e la montagna

en.title: Andrea Moretti, who was the worker who died at the Colosseum: passion for horses and mountains
en.summary: A 22-year-old construction worker from Teramo province who specialized in high-altitude monument work died in an accident. His father had previously lost a leg in a separate incident.

stories.title: L’Estranea, l’horror di Paolo Strippoli rappresenterà l’Italia nella corsa agli Oscar

en.title: L'Estranea, Paolo Strippoli's horror film will represent Italy in the Oscar race
en.summary: An Italian horror film has been selected to compete for an Academy Award nomination. The official shortlist will be announced on December 15, with the final selection revealed on January 21.

stories.title: Uccisa a 25 anni, mutilata e abbandonata in un’auto. Fermato l’ex compagno. Orrore a Nizza

en.title: Killed at 25, mutilated and abandoned in a car. Ex-partner arrested. Horror in Nice
en.summary: Brazilian model Larissa Brito, 25, was found mutilated in a vehicle in Nice. A 29-year-old Algerian man, her ex-partner, has been detained; she had confided to friends about fearing him.

stories.title: Andrea Moretti, il rocciatore morto a 22 anni sul Colosseo: i cavalli, l’Abruzzo, il mestiere del padre

en.title: Andrea Moretti, the climber who died at 22 on the Colosseum: horses, Abruzzo, his father's profession
en.summary: A 22-year-old specialized worker from Teramano died in a work accident. His father had previously left the same profession after a serious injury, and local authorities described the young man as cheerful and devoted to his region and animals.

stories.title: "Cristo è morto a Gaza": 'Preti contro il genocidio' in corteo a Roma, sul sudario 330 nomi di bimbi

en.title: "Christ is dead in Gaza": 'Priests against genocide' march in Rome, 330 children's names on shroud
en.summary: Approximately 100 priests from eight countries marched through Rome carrying a shroud with 330 names identified as Palestinian and Lebanese children killed following ceasefire agreements. The procession ended at Leonardo's headquarters in Piazza Monte Grappa.

stories.title: A Roma la marcia dei preti contro il genocidio: sfila uno striscione con i nomi di 300 bambini palestinesi e libanesi uccisi

en.title: March of priests against genocide in Rome: banner with names of 300 Palestinian and Lebanese children killed
en.summary: Priests organized a march in Rome to commemorate Palestinian and Lebanese children killed following ceasefire agreements, displaying a banner with approximately 300 names.

stories.title: Veneto orientale, l’export cresce sia dentro che fuori la Ue

en.title: Eastern Veneto, exports grow both inside and outside the EU
en.summary: Exports from eastern Veneto continue to increase despite geopolitical uncertainties, risks, and record-high commercial barriers, according to analysis by Confindustria Veneto Est using Istat data.

stories.title: Invitalia, 37,5 milioni di investimenti con Melinda. Mattarella in visita a Cles

en.title: Invitalia, 37.5 million in investments with Melinda. Mattarella visits Cles
en.summary: Invitalia completed two development programs with Melinda Consortium since 2024, involving a facility in Cles and a world-first apple transport cable car system.

stories.title: Venduto all’asta lo storico Grand Hotel di Riccione

en.title: Historic Grand Hotel of Riccione sold at auction
en.summary: A limited liability company from Rimini purchased the historic Grand Hotel of Riccione at auction for over 29.3 million euros after 16 rounds of bidding.

stories.title: Corleone, la finanza entra al liceo su richiesta degli studenti

en.title: Corleone, finance enters high school at students' request
en.summary: A scientific high school has introduced a new educational program addressing student questions about managing savings and identifying financial fraud.

stories.title: Ludoil chiude l’acquisto del 51% di Isab: 1,3 miliardi di investimenti a Priolo

en.title: Ludoil completes purchase of 51% of Isab: 1.3 billion in investments in Priolo
en.summary: Italian company Ludoil finalized its acquisition of a 51% stake in the Isab refinery in Priolo from Cyprus-based Goi Energy, involving 1.3 billion euros in investments.
